tiers: Craft tier 1 weapons you have blueprints for
Gilded cages and +50% ore from scrapping
Craft tier 4 weapons and +10% weapon damage

garden.blurb: Fungal creatures grow food for the whole hideout.

tiers: Every creature gains 5 bond per day
Companions get +10% max HP in raids

roost.name: Roost
roost.blurb: Echo creatures scout the dungeon ahead of you.
tiers: Mark rooms that hold rare creatures
Show secret rooms on the map

75 XP a day and the Trait Tutor opens
